inventoryContract.sensitiveContentPolicy: paths matching local/private/secret-risk are classified without hashing or reading content

reachability.method: Untracked product JS/TS modules compared with the explicit production runtime-integrity inventory and a source-reference scan. Runtime-referenced exceptions require an FS0-03 inventory decision; the remaining barrel is test-only.

generatedDuplication.rule: Source docs are reviewed inputs; generated HTML and integrity catalogs must be regenerated from and digest-bound to the exact candidate, never hand-reconciled.

blockers: CF-FS0-02 must freeze historical evidence and choose a durable version-controlled tracker home.
CF-FS0-03 must assign explicit production authority to every capability and decide source/test-only barrels.
CF-FS0-04 must materialize the clean candidate/package/generated-artifact boundary.

paths.reason: Generated public projection or integrity lock; regenerate and bind it to the exact candidate.
